articles.title: US Supreme Court ends suit alleging Cisco helped China pursue Falun Gong
articles.summary: WASHINGTON, June 23 (Reuters) - The U. Supreme Court further limited the reach of a federal law used to hold corporations liable for human rights abuses committed abroad, as it issued a ruling on Tuesday ending a lawsuit by members of the Falun Gong movement accusing Cisco ‌Systems of facilitating religious persecution in China.

articles.title: Cisco Stock Looks Strong, But One Number Says Be Careful
articles.summary: After an 87% run over the last year (as of June 18), it’s hard to find much fault with Cisco Systems (CSCO) stock. The company is posting record revenue, and its AI-related orders are surging.
